question: Should Discord support an explicit configured role-ID wake list, and should one matching role mention intentionally activate every bot configured for that role?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive activation policy and can intentionally fan out work across multiple agents; source evidence does not establish one safe default.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in role triggers
options.body: Add a separate selected-role activation field in the Discord plugin, preserving current direct-mention and sender-role semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader access-policy design
options.body: Resolve role-trigger behavior only as part of the broader Discord access-list direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748.

options.title: Keep direct mentions only
options.body: Decline multi-agent role fan-out and retain the existing per-bot direct-mention contract.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in role triggers
recommendation.body: Add a separate selected-role activation field in the Discord plugin, preserving current direct-mention and sender-role semantics.
